waivers.reason: BAPI-05 removes globally advertised 415 responses from routes that never perform the auth JSON content-type check; the four actual auth JSON parsing endpoints retain and test their 415 contract. This waiver is valid only for these exact before/after OpenAPI bytes.

BAPI-01 replaces non-standard `le` metadata with real JSON Schema numeric bounds and publishes the lower bounds already enforced by the request models. This exact contract correction was reviewed together with focused boundary tests.

BAPI-01 replaces non-standard `le` metadata with standards-compliant `maximum` constraints matching the existing runtime request limits. This exact contract correction was reviewed together with focused boundary tests.
